messages.content: my sister and i are going to the market. i need fruit and she has to buy a bag.
you can go together and each look for what you need.
i already have a bag. do i need another one?
not from what you said. you said your sister has to buy a bag.
she just found her bag at home.
now she may not need to buy a bag. you still need fruit.
i want apples, but she would like bread too.
you can look for apples for you and bread for your sister.
just say what we still need to buy.
apples for you and bread for your sister.
my aunt and uncle will visit in the evening. i will be home with my mother.
your aunt and uncle will come to visit you and your mother in the evening.
how many people will be at home then, if there is no other person?
four people: you, your mother, your aunt, and your uncle.
my uncle cannot come now.
then there will be three people: you, your mother, and your aunt.
does that change when my aunt is coming?
not from what you said. she is still coming in the evening.
what changed?
who is coming changed. your uncle cannot come.
i wrote two things in my story: the girl went home. she ate rice. change only what she ate.
you could change the last sentence to: she ate soup.
now give me both with the change.
the girl went home. she ate soup.
i want the food to be bread instead.
the girl went home. she ate bread.
did you change where she went?
no. she still went home.
just give me the first sentence alone.
the girl went home.
i want to clean my kitchen, but i feel tired.
you could choose one small part to do now.
i can wash one cup and put my plate away.
that can be your small plan for now.
is doing just that not enough?
it can be enough for now. you can choose to do just a little work when you are tired.
i washed the cup. the plate is still on the table.
you finished the cup. you can put the plate away next if you still want to.
i will leave it for later.
okay. you did one part and chose to rest before the other.
write a sentence with i have a boat.
i have a boat on the water.
i do not have a boat. i just want the words in a story.
okay. the sentence can be part of a story, not a thing we know about you.
can you use a place i know, like the park?
i have a little boat at the park.
now make it about a girl instead of me.
a girl has a little boat at the park.
who has the boat in the last sentence?
a girl in the story.
help me write a note for my teacher. i do not have my book today.
i do not have my book today.
add that i left it at home.
i left my book at home, so i do not have it today.
i want to ask if i can read with another student.
i left my book at home. could i please read with another student today?
does that say i lost the book?
no. it says you left it at home.
keep that reason in the short note.
i left my book at home. could i read with another student today?
i want tea and my brother would like water.
you want tea, and your brother would like water.
my brother would like juice instead now.
you still want tea. your brother would like juice now.
what should i make for me?
tea.
i have no juice. what should i ask him?
you could ask if he would like water or another drink you have.
can you just choose tea for him because i like it?
you can ask if he would like tea, but what you like does not tell us what he would like.
i wrote a note, but water got on the paper and i cannot read it now.
can you remember what you want the note to say?
it was to ask my sister to bring my coat.
you could write it again on another piece of paper: could you please bring my coat?
she is coming tomorrow. add that.
could you please bring my coat when you come tomorrow?
do i have to make up a new note because the paper changed?
no. you can use the same words on another piece of paper.
just the words i should write.
could you please bring my coat when you come tomorrow?
which is near, the park or the library?
near to which place?
near my house. the park is by my street and the library is in another town.
from what you said, the park is near your house.
but i am at the library now.
if you mean near where you are now, you are already at the library.
i mean which one is near my house.
the park.
why did you ask the place at the start?
we need to know which place you mean when you say near.
i did not bring the book i said i would bring. help me say sorry.
i am sorry i did not bring the book.
add that i can bring it tomorrow.
i am sorry i did not bring the book. i can bring it tomorrow.
do not say the other person did that.
i am sorry i did not bring the book. i can bring it tomorrow.
who is the i in the note?
you are. the note is in your voice.
can you make the last part a question instead?
i am sorry i did not bring the book. can i bring it tomorrow?
i have a red cup, a blue cup, and a red book. tell me the red things.
a red cup and a red book.
now just tell me the cups.
the red cup and the blue cup.
do not leave the blue cup out because it is not red.
right. now you asked for cups, so both cups should be in the answer.
which thing is not a cup?
the red book.
just the name, no color.
book.
i have five apples for two children. i want to give them the same number.
you can give each child two apples and keep one apple left over.
why not give one child three?
if one child gets three and the other gets two, they do not get the same number.
what if i eat one apple first?
you would have four apples left and could give two to each child.
how many apples would be left after that?
zero apples.
did each child get the same number?
yes. each child got two apples.
help me write a kind note to my new neighbor.
hello. it is nice to meet you. welcome to the street.
i have not met her in person.
hello. welcome to the street. i hope we can meet.
do not say we had a nice talk.
hello. welcome to the street. i hope we can meet.
can you add that i live next door?
hello. i live next door. welcome to the street. i hope we can meet.
did we say we already met?
no. the note says you hope to meet.
can you change this?
what would you like me to change? please share the words too.
i mean this: please come tomorrow.
how would you like to change it: make it a question, make it shorter, or change the day?
make it a question.
could you please come tomorrow?
now change the day to today.
could you please come today?
did you add more words because i asked for a new day?
no. i only changed tomorrow to today in the question.
my friend has not answered my note. does she not like me?
we do not know that. she could be busy or not have read it.
she said she would be working this afternoon.
she may be working now. that could be why she has not answered.
is that the only reason she could have?
no. it could be that she is working, but we do not know for sure.
i will wait for her answer.
okay. you do not have to choose a reason before you hear from her.
what did she really say?
she said she would be working this afternoon.
my brother said he will wash the cups after lunch. are they clean now?
not from that sentence. he said he will wash them later.
he just said he finished washing them.
now he says the cups are clean.
did you see him wash them?
no. i only know what you said he said.
can you write a note to thank him?
thank you for washing the cups.
keep it short like that.
thank you for washing the cups.
my coat is on the chair and my keys are in the bag. where is my coat, and where are my keys?
your coat is on the chair. your keys are in the bag.
now just answer the keys part.
your keys are in the bag.
did my coat move?
you did not say it moved. it is still on the chair from what you said.
i moved it to the bed.
now your coat is on the bed.
answer about both the coat and keys again.
your coat is on the bed. your keys are in the bag.
i wrote: a boy lost his ball. he went home sad. can you give it a happy end?
a boy lost his ball. his friend found it, and they played together.
keep the part that he went home.
a boy lost his ball and went home. his friend brought it back to him, and he felt happy.
do not add another place.
a boy lost his ball and went home. his friend brought the ball to his house, and he felt happy.
where did the friend bring the ball?
when the boy was at home, the friend brought the ball there.
just say the place.
home.
i will take my coat if there is rain. i have my coat in my bag.
okay. your coat is in your bag.
does that mean there is rain for sure?
no. you can bring a coat even if there is no rain.
i put it there yesterday because i did not want to forget it.
your coat can be in the bag because you put it there yesterday.
what can you say for sure about the weather now?
i do not know the weather now from what you said.
what can you say about the coat?
you said it is in your bag.
i need to get ready for school. i have to find my book, put it in my bag, and leave.
find your book, put it in your bag, then leave.
can i put it in the bag before i find it?
you need to find the book first so you can put it in the bag.
i found it on the table.
now you can put it in your bag.
i did that. what is left in the plan?
leave for school.
what is already done?
you found your book and put it in your bag.
write a note saying i may visit tomorrow.
i may visit tomorrow.
do not make it sound like i am sure.
i may visit tomorrow, but i am not sure.
add that i will tell her later.
i may visit tomorrow. i will tell you later when i know for sure.
does that say i will visit for sure?
no. it says you may visit and will tell her later.
just give me a very short note with may.
i may visit tomorrow.
i have two bags. one has three apples and the other has two. how many bags do i have?
you have two bags.
how many apples?
five apples.
if i put all the apples in one bag, do i have only one bag?
no. you still have two bags, but only one has the apples in it.
how many apples would be in that bag?
five apples.
how many apples in the other bag?
zero apples.
give me a sentence i can write about my family.
i like to have lunch with my family.
we do not have lunch together, but we do have dinner.
i like to have dinner with my family.
can you add at home?
i like to have dinner with my family at home.
did i tell you that we eat lunch together?
no. you said you do not have lunch together.
which meal should the sentence use now?
dinner.
i want to answer my friend with maybe tomorrow. is that the same as saying yes?
no. maybe tomorrow says it could be tomorrow, but it is not sure.
i am sure i can come tomorrow. what should i say?
yes, i can come tomorrow.
can you make it kind?
yes, thank you. i can come tomorrow.
do not say maybe now.
yes, thank you. i can come tomorrow.
what changed about my answer?
you are sure now, so your answer says yes instead of maybe.
my new cup is purple. please remember that while we talk.
your new cup is purple.
what is two and two?
four.
give me a sentence with morning.
i read in the morning.
now what color is the cup i said i have?
purple.
did the morning sentence change its color?
no. it was just a sentence. your cup is still purple from what you said.
help me plan a trip to the park.
when would you like to go?
wait. i only have time for a short question about a word.
okay. what word would you like help with?
return. what does it mean with a book?
if you return a book, you give it back.
give me one sentence with that.
i will return the book tomorrow.
do you still need the time for my park trip?
no. we changed from the trip plan to talking about return.
write a kind sentence asking someone to move their bag from a chair.
could you please move your bag from this chair?
just the sentence. do not explain it.
could you please move your bag from this chair?
add that i would like to sit.
could you please move your bag so i can sit here?
is it still a question?
yes.
now just the question one more time.
could you please move your bag so i can sit here?
my cup is to the left of my book. where is the book from the cup?
if the cup is on the left of the book, the book is on the right of the cup.
does that mean the book is on the left too?
no. from the cup, the book is to the right.
what if i move the cup to the right of the book?
then the book will be to the left of the cup.
did i say i moved it already?
no. you asked what if you moved it.
so where is it in the first plan?
the cup is to the left of the book.
i am waiting at home for my sister. ask me a simple question so we can talk.
what would you like to do when your sister comes?
we want to make lunch together.
what are you thinking of making?
rice and soup.
do you both enjoy making food?
yes. i just want to talk about that, not learn how to cook.
okay. what do you like about making lunch together?
we can talk while we work.
you enjoy having time to talk while you make the meal.
hello. what is this?
hello. i am picoboi, a small llm you can talk with in this webpage.
do you have another name?
you can call me pico too.
can you tell me a true thing about where you run?
i run in your browser.
does that mean you know all the things on my computer?
no. running in your browser does not mean i can see everything on your computer.
what can you use to answer me here?
i can use the words you type here and some of what we said before.
